info.title: Ephemera API
info.description: Temporary email platform API for developers. Create disposable inboxes, receive emails, extract OTP codes, and integrate with webhooks.

key.description: Full API key - only shown once

post.description: Authenticate user and receive JWT token. If 2FA is enabled, returns tempToken for verification.
Create a new user account. Email verification may be required.

400.description: Validation error or email already exists

post.description: Complete login by verifying TOTP code when 2FA is enabled.

get.description: Retrieve all inboxes for the authenticated user with pagination.

post.description: Create a temporary email inbox. If no localPart is provided, a random one will be generated.

get.description: Retrieve a specific inbox by its ID.

delete.description: Delete an inbox and all its messages.

post.description: Create multiple inboxes at once. Maximum 10 per request.

get.description: List messages with optional filtering by inbox, search query, and read status.
Retrieve a specific message with full content and attachments.

delete.description: Delete a message and its attachments.

patch.description: Update the read status of a message.

get.description: Full-text search across all messages in user inboxes.
Retrieve all webhooks configured for the authenticated user.

post.description: Create a new webhook endpoint. A secret will be generated for signature verification.
Send a test payload to the webhook endpoint.

get.description: Get all available webhook event types that can be subscribed to.

post.description: Utility endpoint to verify a webhook signature. Useful for debugging.
